_note: Scenarios for E3-02 (points ledger). Each case describes a sequence of movements and the expected balance, to verify hard rules 3.3 (snapshot), 3.4 (immutable ledger) and 3.9 (integer pesos). Dates are relative to `hoy` (today) so tests do not depend on the calendar: the runner resolves `hoy-30d` with Carbon in America/Bogota. Points are signed integers. `regla_id`/`regla_version` are the mandatory snapshot. Movement fields use the database column names (Spanish domain names).
_decision: The `redencion` type is removed from the `movimientos_puntos` enum (E3-02 spec, issue #8): under hard rule 3.1 using a benefit never costs points, and redemptions live in their own table.

cases._description: Simple accrual. The balance grows by exactly the movement's points, inside the same transaction.
cases._e3_02_criterion: the balance grew by exactly N in the same transaction

cases._description: Reversal within the window. Inserts a negative movement that references the original transaction; the original stays untouched.
cases._e3_02_criterion: reversal within the window: negative movement + original untouched + balance subtracted

cases._description: Reversal outside the window (transaction from 31 days ago). It must be rejected; no movement is inserted.
cases._e3_02_criterion: transaction from 31 days ago: reversal rejected

cases._description: Reversal exactly at the window limit (transaction from 30 days ago). The window is inclusive: it is accepted.
cases._e3_02_criterion: reversal on the last day of the window: accepted

cases._description: Double reversal of the same transaction. The second one is rejected and inserts nothing.
cases._e3_02_criterion: transaction already reversed: second reversal rejected

cases._description: Manual adjustment with a reason and a user. It fixes a mistake without touching previous movements.
cases._e3_02_criterion: manual adjustment records the reason and the user

movimientos.motivo: Corrección de doble registro del cajero

cases._description: Manual adjustment without a reason. It is rejected: every adjustment must explain why it was made.
cases._e3_02_criterion: manual adjustment without a reason: rejected

cases._description: Movement that would leave the balance below zero. It is rejected: the balance is never negative.
cases._e3_02_criterion: movement that leaves a negative balance: rejected

cases._description: Expiry: points that expired leave through a negative `caducidad` movement. (The job is E3-05; here we only check the ledger supports it.)
cases._e3_02_criterion: expiry subtracts from the balance with its own movement

cases._description: Recalculation from scratch. Adding up every movement must give the materialized balance.
Immutability: trying to UPDATE or DELETE an existing movement must fail at the model level.
Rollback: if the operation fails halfway, neither the movement nor the balance change remain.
cases._e3_02_criterion: rollback leaves no movement and no balance change
